reviews.text: fun way to learn Japanese as a beginner. Nice music too

It has some strategy other than just remembering Japanese words, so it feels like playing a real game, not just doing flashcards. It's hard to stop playing once you start, which seems like a good quality when it's also helping you review Japanese.
In this roguelike management game, players run a haunted izakaya sitting on a spiritual leyline. To survive yokai attacks and satisfy customers, you must decipher a Japanese recipe book.
this is the perfect game , if your trying to learn japanese highly recommend checking it out. its cute, not too complicated in terms of mechanics. just need to remember how to spell lol
Roguelike card battler that teaches Japanese while you play. Master words to serve yokai customers. Deep strategy, daily challenges.
Great presentation and a very polished UI. Clearly made with care. Had one bug with a level not ending, but otherwise very enjoyable. Achievements and local co-op would be great additions.
A roguelike card battler that uses Japanese vocabulary flashcards as core combat mechanics. You can start from the basics like Hiragana or adjust the difficulty up to N1.
